title: Add approval binding diff and stale expired token UX
purpose: Make approval mutation, expiry and stale token risk explicit in the operator experience.
scope: Render parameter hash and human-readable parameter summary side by side.
Render changed parameter or token mismatch as denied preview state.
Show expiry countdown or expired timestamp in deterministic form.
Add stale-token fixtures for focused approval actions.
Prevent keyboard shortcuts from bypassing stale or expired checks.
acceptance_criteria: Approval mutation is rejected before EffectPrepared.
Expired approvals cannot be submitted from panel or palette.
Binding diff does not leak raw secrets.
Tests cover focused-panel stale token reuse.
failure_modes: Only run id is checked and parameter mutation slips through.
Diff renderer exposes raw secret-like input.
